input.prompt: Speak as a warm, conversational Turkish narrator addressing one curious listener. Sound like a thoughtful person sharing a discovery as it becomes clear, with natural human cadence, varied sentence energy, and quiet curiosity. Let short reveal sentences land, then slow slightly for explanation. Use clear Istanbul Turkish diction and natural pauses. Avoid sermon, classroom lecture, documentary-announcer delivery, exaggerated drama, and a repeated rhetorical rise-and-fall. Do not give every section the same cadence. Pronounce Arabic Quranic words naturally as Arabic, then return smoothly to Turkish.
input.text: ٱلْغَفُورُ (cok bagislayan/koruyarak orten), ilk sifat olarak يَسْتَغْفِرُونَ (bagislanma dilerler), fiiline kokten geri doner. Melekler bagislanma ister; Allah "el-Gafur" diye adlandirilir. Kelimenin yogun bicimi, tek bir affi degil bol ve surekli bagislayiciligi duyurur; koruyucu ortme alani da bu affi siper haline getirir. Son kelime ٱلرَّحِيمُ (merhametli/rahim)dir. Rahmet burada bagislamanin yanina eklenen yumusak bir duygu gibi degil, bagislamayi olumlu bakim ve hayat koruyan sevecenlikle tamamlayan ikinci isimdir. Kelimenin rahim, yakinlik ve koruyucu ic alanla komsu dokusu, merhameti yerinde tutar: Allah hakkinda bedenlestirme yapmadan, korunmus hayat alanini hatirlatan bir sicaklik verir.
